# tey/starter

> The new-app template for tenant-aware Laravel apps, built on tey/kit with every feature added: workspaces and invitations, versioned settings and Notes shared by session pages and MCP tools, with Fortify sessions, Inertia/Vue pages and Passport OAuth. Public but unsupported; use at your own risk.

- [README](README.md): overview, `composer setup` and check commands
- [Architecture](docs/architecture.md): tey/kit, the packages and the job each one owns
- [Operations](docs/operations.md): settings and Notes shared operations, versions, intent keys, audit
- [Transports](docs/transports.md): session/Inertia and MCP/OAuth, scopes, consent
- [Lifecycle](docs/lifecycle.md): install, kit features, migrations from 0.2 and kit updates
- [Deploy](docs/deploy.md): the Laravel Cloud deploy command order
- [Testing](docs/testing.md): the gates and focused checks
- [Roadmap](ROADMAP.md): what is shipped and what is planned
- [Agent conventions](AGENTS.md): rules for contributors and coding agents

## Machine-readable maps

- [MCP capabilities](docs/mcp-capabilities.json): the MCP inventory (v1): server, scopes and tools
- [Package map](docs/package-map.json): locked packages and what has been executed
- [Conformance](docs/conformance.json): acceptance scenario dispositions
- [Feature transports](docs/feature-transports.json): which operation is reachable over which transport
- [Generation manifest](docs/generation-manifest.json): generated files
